name: Great South West Walk
description: A loop from Portland: inland through the Cobboboonee forest and along the Glenelg River to Nelson, then back along Discovery Bay and over Cape Bridgewater and Cape Nelson. The Great Trails Victoria dataset this is built from was last updated in 2019.
